why: ChatGPT treated this as a pick-one-camera question: it recommended three standalone SD-card models (GardePro E5 2.0, Bushnell Core S-4K, Core DS-4K) and named no required accessory beyond the storage built into the concept. The shopper's real decision is which offline camera to buy, which turns on Wi-Fi vs cellular vs fully offline, not on any connector or compatibility fact across a set, so a single comparison page fits.
